Ascend Capital Llc who had been investing in Celldex Therapeutics Inc New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $96.30 million market cap company. (NASDAQ:CLDX) has declined 30.36% since May 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 41.91% the S&P500.
